The '''Void Knights' Outpost''' is a small island in the [[Ardent Ocean]] occupied by the [[Void Knights]] just south-west of [[Ape Atoll]]. It serves as the hub for the [[minigame]] [[Pest Control]].

==Transportation==
Several methods of reaching the island exist:

* {{plink|Minigame teleport|pic=Minigame icon}} to [[Pest Control]] — island centre.
* {{plink|Pest control teleport|txt=Pest Control teleport scroll}} — island centre.
* Talking to a [[Squire (Void Knights)|Squire]] on the [[Port Sarim|Port Sarim docks]], which can be accessed quickly via [[charter ship|charter ships]] across [[Gielinor]].
* [[Sailing]] to and mooring at the island, requiring level 50 [[Sailing]].

Around the island, players can talk to any of the [[Void Knights]] to buy [[Void Knight Equipment]] and upgrade the [[Elite Void Knight equipment]].

=== Pest Control ===
The main feature of the island is [[Pest Control]], a co-operative multi-player [[combat]] [[minigame]]. The landers at the south side of the island brings players to the [[Pest Control Island|Pest Control island]] when there are 5-25 players in them. The official world for Pest Control is world 344.

==Sailing info==
Players can [[mooring point|dock]] at the Void Knights' Outpost with level 50 [[Sailing]]. The dock north of the town offers the following utilities for sailors:
*[[File:Port task board icon.png|link=Notice board]] [[Notice board]]
*[[File:Salvaging station map icon.png|link=Salvaging station]] [[Salvaging station]]
*[[File:Ledger table icon.png|link=Ledger table]] [[Ledger table]]
*[[File:Bank icon.png|link=Bank deposit box]] [[Bank deposit box]]

== Inhabitants ==
Note that all characters below named "squire" don't have any additional information in their names, and are instead located near their shop or utility.

* {{Chatl|Dodgy Squire|text=Dodgy squire}}, who can refund 80% of the points used to buy [[Void Knight equipment|void knight equipment]] to the player.
* {{Chatl|Elite Void Knight|text=Elite Void Knight}}, who can upgrade a player's [[Void Knight equipment|void knight equipment]].
* {{Chatl|Squire (Void Knights general store)|text=General store squire}}, who runs the island's [[general store]].
* {{Chatl|Squire (Void Knights magic shop)|text=Magic shop squire}}, who runs the island's magic shop.
* {{Chatl|Port master|pic=Port master (Void Knights' Outpost) chathead}}, who helps players with their [[port tasks]].
* {{Chatl|Squire (Void Knights ranged shop)|text=Ranged shop squire}}, who sells
* {{Chatl|Squire (Void Knights)|text=Squires}}, who help explain the game and island.
* {{Chatl|Squire (Void Knights banker)|pic=Squire (Void Knights banker, male) chathead|text=Squire bankers}}, who help players access their banks.
* {{Chatl|Squire (Void Knights smith)|text=Squire blacksmith}}, who can [[Degradation|repair]] a player's items.
* {{Chatl|Squire (Novice)}}, who runs the [[Pest Control#Rewards|novice Pest Control boat]].
* {{Chatl|Squire (Intermediate)}}, who runs the [[Pest Control#Rewards|intermediate Pest Control boat]].
* {{Chatl|Squire (Veteran)}}, who runs the [[Pest Control#Rewards|veteran Pest Control boat]].
* {{Chatl|Void Knight|text=Void Knights|pic=Void Knight (4) chathead}}, who give training in exchange for [[Void Knight commendation points|commendation points]].
